verdict.rationale: LegalOS documents end-to-end EB-1A and EB-2 NIW services, from eligibility and evidence or proposed-endeavor strategy through attorney review and USCIS filing. It also runs a separate O-1 service, and its startup page promises help identifying the right "visa or green card path." However, nothing in the evidence explicitly ties the two together as an O-1-to-green-card continuation strategy; the link is only implied by offering both. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the O-1 → EB-1A/NIW transition (reusing O-1 evidence, timing, dual intent), a founder-specific continuation roadmap, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
